newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara to free merchant banks further.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara to free merchant banks further.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia announced on Tuesday it would lift the minimum 30-percent fee-based income requirement for merchant banks.
The central bank Governor Ahmad Mohd Don announced that the requirement, imposed 17 years ago, would come to an end on January 1, 1997, a Bank Negara statement said.
Bank Negara said in a statement issued after its annual meeting with chief executives of merchant banks that the move to lift the requirement was part of its efforts to liberalise the industry.
"Notwithstanding this, Bank Negara Malaysia reminded the industry to be mindful of their specialised role," the statement said.
"Bank Negara Malaysia will continue to monitor their activities in this area," the statement said.
